A post must belong to exactly one author, as specified by the author_id field in the Post entity.
A post can have zero or more tags, as defined by the PostTag junction table linking post_id and tag_id.
A tag can be associated with zero or more posts, as defined by the PostTag junction table linking post_id and tag_id.
When a post is searched by tag, only posts that are explicitly linked to that tag through the PostTag table are returned.
Each post must have a title and content, as required by the Post entity schema.
Each tag must have a unique name, as enforced by the tag name field in the Tag entity.
An author must have a name and email, as defined in the Author entity schema.
The PostTag table enforces a many-to-many relationship between posts and tags, ensuring that each post-tag association is uniquely identified by a combination of post_id and tag_id.
A post cannot be created without an associated author, as the author_id field in the Post entity references the author_id in the Author entity.
A tag cannot be created without a unique name, as duplicate tag names are not allowed in the Tag entity.
